name: black-amber-coffee-monorepo
description: Orquestrador Full-Stack do Black Amber Coffee (Database PostgreSQL + Backend Express/TS + Frontend React Admin & Client)

scripts.install:all: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix Backend install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix Frontend install --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.setup: npm run setup:env && npm run install:all
scripts.db:up: npm run setup:env && docker compose up -d --build --wait postgres adminer
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build --wait postgres adminer
scripts.dev: npm run setup:env && docker compose stop backend funcionario-adm cliente && docker compose up -d --build --wait postgres adminer && concurrently -n "API,ADMIN,CLIENT" -c "green,cyan,yellow" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.docker:up: npm run setup:env && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.docker:up:logs: npm run setup:env && docker compose up --build
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.build: npm --prefix Backend run build && npm --prefix Frontend run build:admin && npm --prefix Frontend run build:client
scripts.test: npm --prefix Backend test && npm --prefix Frontend test -w admin-app && npm --prefix Frontend test -w client-app
